ruler-persistence-no-world: Ruler coordinates cannot be saved because this world's identity is unavailable.
ruler-persistence-unsupported: The saved ruler file uses an unsupported format. It has not been overwritten; ruler edits remain unsaved until the file is repaired.
ruler-persistence-invalid-entry: This world's saved ruler is invalid and was not loaded. Set an endpoint to replace this world's entry.
ruler-persistence-load-failed: The saved ruler file could not be read. It has not been overwritten; check the game log.
ruler-persistence-save-failed: Ruler coordinates could not be saved and may be lost after restart. The next endpoint edit or world exit will retry.
ruler-persistence-cleanup-failed: A temporary ruler config file could not be removed. Check the game log.
ruler-create: Ruler: left-click terrain to create the missing endpoint(s). Right-click or Escape cancels.
ruler-aim-at-block: Ruler: target loaded terrain within the camera view.
ruler-axis-unavailable: This ruler axis cannot follow the current viewing angle safely. Adjust your view and try again.
ruler-invalid-endpoint: That ruler position is outside valid coordinates or belongs to another dimension.
ruler-dimension-mismatch: The ruler belongs to another dimension. Return there to see and edit it.
ruler-render-unavailable: The ruler wireframe is unavailable for this world session. Sizes still work; check the game log.
gizmo-render-unavailable: In-world editing controls are unavailable for this world session. Measurements and saved values still work; check the game log.
gizmo-input-unavailable: In-world editing input is unavailable for this world session. Measurements and saved values still work; check the game log.
itemdesc-buildhammer-*: A keepsake wooden hammer. Build mode is available through its configurable hotkey.
